title: Dual strain regulated RhNiAu trimetallene for efficient plasmonic-promoted acidic nitrate electroreduction
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4971-4981
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00788G, Paper
Wei Zhong, Qing-Ling Hong, Qiu-Yu Du, Bao Yu Xia, Xuan Ai, Fu-Min Li, Yu Chen
Dual strain regulated RhNiAu trimetallene effectively suppresses the competitive hydrogen evolution reaction and accelerates acidic nitrate electroreduction kinetics, while the anchored Au nanocrystal enables plasmon-enhanced catalytic performance.
